meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run e68jn: resources chosen by the written rules; every row of every sheet or CSV read (CSV over 20 MB streamed and not stored; large xlsx streamed with ExcelJS); a row is kept when it is a zone row (harvest-log.json meta.rules.zone_row): zone OA/LSOA/MSOA/ward code, zone postcode or postcode sector, zone UPRN or TOID, or coordinates in the 3D model box. zone_keys gives the key that matched, row by row. header_rows: the rows above the first data row.
selection_notes: 1 format variants of a picked stem not read
name keys: 50 zone station names (zone-names.json); a cell equal to one (normalised) is a zone row, a weaker key than a code
